name: Happy Horse
description: Generate videos from a text prompt, an image, or both.

action.description: Generate videos from a text prompt, an image, or both.
action.name: alibaba/happy-horse/image-to-video

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated video. Used for text-to-video (no image); ignored when an image is provided.
aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio

image_url.description: URL of the first frame image. Formats: JPEG, JPG, PNG, BMP, WEBP. Dimensions must be at least 300px. Aspect ratio must be between 1:2.5 and 2.5:1. Max 10 MB.
image_url.title: Image Url

prompt.description: Optional text prompt guiding the animation. Max 2500 characters.
prompt.title: Prompt

seed.description: Seed value for random number generator. Uncheck for reproducible results.
seed.title: Seed
